description: Classify contract runtime code (eth_getCode hex): EIP-1167 minimal proxy + implementation, EIP-7702 delegation + delegate, EOF, size vs the EIP-170 24576-byte limit, code keccak-256, Solidity metadata (compiler, IPFS hash), notable opcode counts, and heuristic function-selector candidates. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: bytecode_inspect
title: Inspect EVM runtime bytecode (dev tool)
